name: Homelands: race wonders
notes: The ten race wonders of the major homelands (data/homelands.json `wonders`, docs/CONTENT.md section 23): one anomaly event each in events/wonders.json. Every one has weight 0 (the sector's wonder POI runs it by id, nothing rolls it), `once`, is a landmark, asks for the flag in_<region id> and pays its reward on every path that takes anything: a race blueprint or gear piece, once per run.
